responsibility: This definition module declares the fragment-stream facility used when mc wants to build an output file from separately written pieces. It provides routines to open numbered fragment files, designate the final destination stream, concatenate fragments in order, and clean up temporary files, abstracting fragmented output assembly from the code generator.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public declaration side of the mcStream stem, listing fragment-stream operations such as openFrag, setDest, combine, and removeFiles; unlike mcStream.mod, it contains no temporary-file naming, file table, or copy logic.
